recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy duotone portrait of a male figure with long dark hair, featuring a tight crop on the face and clasped hands. The composition is dominated by a large, two-tiered red block containing distressed, hand-drawn typography, accented by a smaller yellow subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: The large red typographic block acts as a heavy visual weight against the light background of the right side.
The grainy, purple-tinted duotone of the skin contrasts with the flat, saturated red and yellow of the graphic elements.
The diagonal line formed by the clasped hands leads the eye upward toward the bold text block.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or halftone texture across the photographic subject.
A vibrant red rectangular background for the primary display text.
A mix of clean geometric letterforms and chaotic, scratched-in lettering.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, with hands in the lower right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid red rectangular block in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eye on the left, moves down to the clasped hands, and follows the upward diagonal to the red text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple-grey duotone for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated red for the primary text background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the desaturated, textured photo and the flat, high-saturation graphic blocks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif and condensed display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a mix of solid, sharp-edged block letters and 'scratched-out' or 'over-painted' glyphs.
The first letter of each word is significantly oversized, breaking the top boundary of the red block.
Secondary text is a wide, geometric, sans-serif font.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'M' characters are elongated with sharp, pointed descenders.
Internal letters feature white and black scratch marks that look like they were carved into the red block.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, distressed display type paired with a clean, wide geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy condensed base for the block lettering.
Matches the wide, geometric feel of the yellow subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy duotone (purple-grey) portrait of a man with long hair, cropped tightly on the face and clasped hands, with a neutral light background on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two horizontal red rectangles in the upper right. Inside them, place large, distressed, hand-drawn black and white uppercase lettering with oversized initials. Below the red blocks, add a single line of wide, bold yellow sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the grain/halftone texture visible across the skin tones?
Do the initial letters of the main title break the top edge of the red blocks?
Is the yellow text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the color palette strictly limited to purple-grey, red, yellow, black, and white?

mustRedesign: specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks integrated into the red blocks via scratching effects.
Check that the duotone doesn't lose all detail in the shadows.
Verify the composition feels 'heavy' on the right side due to the red blocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Portrait + Grain Filter + Red Block Graphic + Distressed Display Type + Yellow Extended Subtitle
